text: {"frames":["You pull the rope of the hoist beam, and the crooked house in the Tower lights up window by window. Nobody is inside, and the glow is warm like a lamp left on for a guest. Behind the glass a small shadow slips past the {c} lit panes and then is gone. The window latches hum when you touch them. How many lamps must you switch off so that exactly half of the {c} glowing windows stay lit?","\"Careful, the cheese is singing again,\" says a voice from the cellar stairs. You follow it down past the shelves, where the round cheeses sit in rows of cold, neat light. Somewhere far off a fiddle is playing a tune nobody has written down. The cheeses hold their breath and the music stops at the {c} wheels nearest you. How many wheels must you turn over so that exactly half of the {c} wheels face the music?","Pim's clogs are gone from the mill step, and the rope to the attic hangs loose. Up the narrow stairs you climb, and the steps keep going past the top of the Tower. On the landing a door stands open to a floor that no plan has ever shown. A gull's feather lies on the sill, and a cold draught smells of wet wood. There are {c} steps on the new stair, and the clogs must be somewhere on the far half. How many steps must you climb to reach exactly half of the {c} steps and find where the clogs went?","Ice creaks under you on the canal, and there is a smell of hot waffles and tar. In the frost a line of footprints starts in the middle of the canal, where no one could have walked. They lead away in pairs of boots, and then the trail goes back again. You count {c} prints in the frost before the snow covers the rest. How many of the {c} prints walk out, if exactly half of them come back the same way?","The tulip field is quiet, and the windmill sails stand still against the grey sky. Someone has counted the clogs by the door every night, always one short. Tonight you stand by the door and find {c} clogs set out in a row. A small note under the last one says the owner will come back to take their share. How many clogs must each of the two..."]}
